semiconductor_relevance: High — Vital Materials specializes in rare and dispersed metals and their applications in semiconductor substrates and advanced materials.
summary: Vital Materials Co., Ltd is a leading global high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, production, sales, and recycling of rare and dispersed metals, which are critical for semiconductor applications. The company is a core supplier of compound semiconductor substrates and provides integrated solutions for various high-tech industries, including microelectronics and photovoltaics.
capabilities: Production of compound semiconductor substrates (GaAs, GaN, InP, SiGe)
Manufacturing of ITO rotating targets for semiconductor applications
Recycling services for rare and dispersed metals
Development of advanced materials for microelectronics
technical_expertise: Materials science for rare and dispersed metals

regional_presence.China: Vital Materials is established in Qingyuan, China, where it has developed significant capabilities in rare and dispersed metals.
